items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-01-13
items.q: That's Alphonse Pico and John Cashman. There's the only two E flat players that I know of.

ctx.x: Well, you've been down there when they had a band in the center? No, I've never had a band in the center. Well, his boy had it this year, John.

items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: I believe you was on that last one when John Cashman was with us.

ctx.x: Well, how long has it been since you've played a funeral with more than one band?
Oh, it's been quite a while. A lot of this about a year or so. I believe you was on that last one when John Cashman was with us. I remember you had two bands. That's it. That's the last one I played.
How many did Celestan's funeral have? Three or?
